text.p: Millipore Corp Tuesday said that it has completed its tender offer for shares of Tylan General Inc, and has acquired more than 99 percent of the outstanding common shares of Tylan.

As of the expiration of the offer on January 21, 1997, more than 8,145,000 shares of Tylan common stock had been tendered. The offer was made through MCTG Acquisition Corp, wholly-owned subsidiary of Millipore Corp.
Millipore will accept for payment all the shares tendered at the tender offer price of $16.00 per share, the company said.

Millipore is a high technology company that applies its purification technology to critical research and manufacturing problems in the microelectronics, biopharmaceutical and analytical laboratory markets.
San Diego-based Tylan makes precision mass flow controllers, ultraclean gas panels and pressure measurement and control equipment.
